title: 100 Years of Death
body:
Syntax: read scroll of 100 years of death  |  perform 100 years of death <target>

Description: An instant-kill technique learned only by reading its scroll. It uses normal mob and PvP defeat handling; safe areas and protected targets remain protected. Scroll-only; it is never unlocked by leveling or login backfill. Costs 100 Chakra and 20 Stamina; 60 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
